quote.text: From colleague Kelly Phares. USSS Director Cheatle and DHS Secretary Mayorkas have declined to testify tomorrow at before the House Homeland Security committee hearing. FBI Director Wray also declined last week – but he will appear before House Judiciary on Wednesday
